lines: Hosh walon ko khabar kya, bekhudi kya cheez hai
couplets.en: What can the clearheaded know of losing themselves?

lines: Hosh walon ko khabar kya, bekhudi kya cheez hai
Ishq kije, phir samajhiye, zindagi kya cheez hai
couplets.en: What can the clearheaded know of losing themselves until they fall in love and learn what it is to live?

lines: Hosh walon ko khabar kya, bekhudi kya cheez hai
couplets.en: What can the clearheaded know of losing themselves?

lines: Unse nazrein kya milin, raushan fizayein ho gayin
couplets.en: Our eyes met, and the very air grew bright.

lines: Unse nazrein kya milin, raushan fizayein ho gayin
Aaj jaana, pyaar ki jaadugari kya cheez hai
couplets.en: Our eyes met and the air grew bright, and today I learned the spell that love can cast.

lines: Aaj jaana, pyaar ki jaadugari kya cheez hai
couplets.en: Today I learned the spell that love can cast.

lines: Ishq kije, phir samajhiye, zindagi kya cheez hai
couplets.en: Fall in love, and you will know what it is to live.

lines: Khulti zulfon ne sikhaayi mausamon ko shayari
couplets.en: That loosening hair taught the seasons poetry.

lines: Khulti zulfon ne sikhaayi mausamon ko shayari
Jukti aankhon ne bataaya, maikashi kya cheez hai
couplets.en: That loosening hair taught the seasons poetry, and those downcast eyes taught me what it is to be drunk.

lines: Jukti aankhon ne bataaya, maikashi kya cheez hai
couplets.en: Those downcast eyes taught me what it is to be drunk.

lines: Ishq kije, phir samajhiye, zindagi kya cheez hai
couplets.en: Fall in love, and you will know what it is to live.

lines: Hum labon se keh na paaye unse haal-e-dil kabhi
couplets.en: I could never tell my beloved what was in my heart.

lines: Hum labon se keh na paaye unse haal-e-dil kabhi
Aur woh samjhe nahin, yeh khamoshi kya cheez hai
couplets.en: I could never tell my beloved what was in my heart, and they never understood what my silence meant.

lines: Aur woh samjhe nahin, yeh khamoshi kya cheez hai
couplets.en: And they never understood what my silence meant.
